summary_rationale: Vertex Pharmaceuticals earns COMPOUNDER_PASS on the strength of its near-monopoly Cystic Fibrosis franchise (~$11.8B FY2025 revenue, 86.2% GAAP gross margin, 34.8% operating margin, $3.19B FCF, and near-flat 10-year diluted share count), reinforced by Alyftrek's rapid uptake ($706M in Q3 2026) which extends core CF patent protection to 2039 while lowering CFF royalty burdens. KPI health is PASS_WITH_WATCH because non-CF diversification—Casgevy ($99M Q3 2026, ATC capacity bottleneck), Journavx ($58M Q3 2026, LSR chronic-pain setback and payer friction), povetacicept (Nov 30, 2026 PDUFA from $4.9B Alpine deal), and Palsonify (from $10.0B Crinetics deal funded partly via a $4.5B term loan)—must scale into multi-billion-dollar contributors ahead of Trikafta's 2037 patent cliff.
